title: Verify staged sensitive blocking and clean commits for LeftBlock/Pudicus
description: Local acceptance remains complete: the exact existing Pudicus hook in a disposable repository accepted clean content with a receipt and rejected a generated sensitive fixture without changing HEAD or exposing its value.
